svg.title: How I build
svg.desc: A terminal types each step, then a short reply follows. find_problem. load_context. give_tools. run_tests --break. evaluate. deploy. tail -f logs. fix --repeat.

g.text: Found something boring enough to automate.

Let it search. Let it act. No guessing.
